lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: BRUNO, DON'T YOU DARE [beat] OPEN THAT GARAGE DOOR UNLESS YOU WANT THE WHOLE NEIGHBORHOOD TO SEE WHAT YOU REALLY DID!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I don't care about the money, Nix [beat] but my limited edition electric scooter doesn't just sprout wings and fly away by itself!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I’m telling you [beat] Nix is the one who took it, I saw him riding it behind the school like he owned the place yesterday!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That's a lie because [beat] I was actually spending my entire weekend working at the repair shop just to fix the motor you fried, Bruno!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, honey, why would you pay [beat] to fix a scooter that isn't even yours when we can barely afford your new school supplies?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because I saw Bruno try to sell it [beat] to pay for his dog’s surgery, but he accidentally broke the engine and panicked like a coward.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I didn't think anyone saw me [beat] but why would you help me after all the times I treated you like absolute garbage at school?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because I’m not a thief [beat] and I realized that seeing you lose your future over one desperate mistake wouldn’t make my life any better.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: So you used your own savings [beat] to fix my scooter just so this kid wouldn't go to juvenile hall for grand larceny? That's insane.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Maybe [beat] but Uncle Jamal, look at the scooter now; it’s faster and cleaner than the day you bought it from the showroom.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: You’ve got a real talent, kid [beat] and since you’ve technically paid for the damages, I’ll drop the charges against Bruno for good.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
